name: Triplane-MLP Network Architecture
definition: A model architecture using lightweight MLPs to predict appearance, geometry, and deformation parameters of individual Gaussians from triplane features, enabling efficient training and fast rendering (60 FPS) by discarding triplane/MLP models after predicting canonical avatar and deformation parameters.
summary: The Triplane-MLP Network Architecture represents 3D human avatars by decoding compact triplane features into Gaussian parameters via lightweight MLPs, enabling fast 60 FPS rendering by discarding models after prediction.
